name: Sister Karen
source:
Sister and theology lecturer at the Academy. Was once expelled from the church because of problems with the authority. Very serious and strong minded she is a fervent believer of God's teachings, as such, she has always being a role model for her students and peers.

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=422446&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
